about: PrompTugal.news's plan and its state, hand-kept by the conductor (newsroom@web-summit.dinis); schema data/schemas/newsroom-plan.schema.json. The newsroom overview draws it live. A note may name a live count in braces, filled at build from the data: {companies}, {articles}, {agenda}, {captures}, {stories}, {people}, {pages}, {releases}, {runs}, {agents_running}. States are a judgement, not a measure; the evidence says why.
